triage.kind_span: This Schedule TO relates to the Fund’s offer to purchase for cash up to 50% or 19,931,845 shares of its outstanding common shares

subject_names.span: This Tender Offer Statement on Schedule TO is filed by Eaton Vance Floating-Rate Income Trust, a Massachusetts business trust (the “Fund”).

subject_tickers.span: The Shares are traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “EFT.”

security_class.span: up to 50% or 19,931,845 shares of its outstanding common shares, 0.01 par value (the “Common Shares”)

price_basis.span: equal to 99% of the net asset value per share as of the Expiration Date

price_pct_nav.span: The purchase price will equal 99% of the Fund’s net asset value (“NAV”) per Share

nav_pricing_date.value: close of regular trading on the NYSE on the date the Offer expires (July 30, 2021, or the extended date)
nav_pricing_date.span: as of the close of regular trading on the New York Stock Exchange (the “NYSE”) on the date the Offer expires, July 30, 2021 (or if the Offer is extended, on the date to which the Offer is extended)

size_pct_outstanding.span: OFFER TO PURCHASE FOR CASH UP TO 50% OR 19,931,845 OF ITS OUTSTANDING COMMON SHARES OF BENEFICIAL INTEREST

size_shares.span: OFFER TO PURCHASE FOR CASH UP TO 50% OR 19,931,845 OF ITS OUTSTANDING COMMON SHARES OF BENEFICIAL INTEREST

commencement_date.span: upon the terms and subject to the conditions set forth in the Fund’s Offer to Purchase dated June 29, 2021

expiration_date.span: The Offer expires on July 30, 2021 at 5:00 p.m., Eastern Time, unless the Fund extends the Offer.

proration.span: If more Shares than the Offer Amount are properly tendered and not withdrawn prior to the date the Offer expires, the Fund will purchase the Offer Amount on a pro rata basis (disregarding fractional shares).

spans: The purchase of Shares in the Offer would result in the delisting of the Shares from the NYSE.
cause the Fund to fail to qualify and to be treated as a regulated investment company under the Internal Revenue Code of 1986
any material legal action or proceeding instituted or threatened challenging such transactions or otherwise materially adversely affecting the Fund
any suspension of or limitation on prices for trading securities generally on the NYSE American, the NYSE or other national securities exchange(s), or the NASDAQ National Market System
the Board determines in good faith, upon written advice of counsel, that effecting any such transaction would constitute a breach of their fiduciary duty owed to the Fund or its Shareholders

The purchase of Shares in the Offer would result in a failure to comply with the applicable asset coverage requirements applicable to any senior securities of the Fund that are issued and outstanding.

trigger_origin.span: EVM and Saba entered into an agreement (the “Agreement”) pursuant to which EVM recommended to the Board, and the Board authorized, the Offer and the three conditional tender offers discussed below

notes: Commencement date taken as the Offer to Purchase date (June 29, 2021); the excerpt does not use the word commencement with a calendar date, though it says August 25, 2021 is 40 business days from commencement. Offer was conditioned on certification of shareholder approval of the new advisory agreement, which the filing says was met on 2021-05-12, so it is not an open condition. Asset-coverage condition is classed other. The filing also describes three future conditional tender offers (Q4 2022-2024, up to 10% at 98% of NAV if average discount over 10% Jan-Aug); these are described as outside this Offer, so no second event is recorded. No results fields: this is the commencement filing.
